title: 2nd string: B, C and D
summary: The same finger pattern, one string lower.

steps.title: B, C and D
text: The open 2nd string is **B**, on the middle line. The space above it is **C**, at the 1st fret. The line above that is **D**, at the 3rd fret.
It is the same pattern as the 1st string: open, first finger, third finger.

steps.title: Joining the strings
text: After **D** on the 2nd string comes the open 1st string, **E**. So you can now read six notes in a row, straight up the staff.

steps.title: Up and back
text: First finger for C, third finger for D. Say the names as you play.

steps.title: Across two strings
text: This one climbs from the 2nd string onto the 1st and comes back down. Watch for the string change between D and E.

steps.title: B, C and D
text: Four bars, mostly on the 2nd string, with a visit to the open 1st string.
